projects.title: BankSphere
projects.description: A banking application organized into Customer, Admin, and Notification services, with Kafka connecting transaction events to notifications.
highlights: Deposits, withdrawals, transfers, transaction history, and PDF statements.
JWT authentication and separate services for customer, admin, and notification workflows.

projects.title: ReconcileAI
projects.description: An invoice-review application that extracts data from PDFs and images, validates vendor, currency, and purchase-order amounts, and keeps a human approval step.
highlights: Google OAuth, role-based access, and PostgreSQL row-level security.
Duplicate prevention, support for four currencies, and uploads up to 8 MB.

projects.title: ViharaVista
projects.description: A hotel-booking application with authenticated user sessions, hotel listings, and a Stripe payment flow.
highlights: End-to-end booking and payment workflows built with the MERN stack.

moreProjects.title: Building Express.js
moreProjects.description: An Express-inspired Node.js library exploring routing and REST API fundamentals.

moreProjects.title: HungerHub
moreProjects.description: A full-stack food-ordering application with restaurant management and Stripe payments.

moreProjects.title: Video Streaming App
moreProjects.description: A React application exploring debounced search, caching, nested comments, and live chat.
